evidence: The paper employs Rasch/IRT methods (Partial Credit Model) for psychometric scale development. Random forest appears only in the imputation step: "the data of individuals with less than 30% of the items missing per assessment Wave was imputed using a random forest-based approach." Item selection for the 33-item functioning metric was determined by prior systematic mapping to ICF (International Classification of Functioning) categories, not by machine-learning-based importance ranking. The analysis focuses entirely on item fit, local dependencies, unidimensionality, and differential item functioning—standard psychometric properties—with no variable importance or ranking used for substantive conclusions.
